title: Symbolic user functions copy their constant matrix arguments at every call
author: Claude-JG
description: Found by revision2026c step RG12.2: the springForceTorqueUserFunction of ObjectConnectorRigidBodySpringDamper takes two 6x6 and two 3x3 matrices, 90 values copied into the named symbolic matrices per call; it costs 0.41 microseconds against 0.23 for the 3D vectors of CartesianSpringDamper. Arguments that are parameters of the item could be copied only when the parameter changes.
releaseNotes: The fixed-size vector and matrix arguments of symbolic user functions (std::array: Vector2D/3D/6D, Matrix3D/6D) are copied into the named leaves in one pass instead of component by component: the springForceTorqueUserFunction of ObjectConnectorRigidBodySpringDamper takes 0.43 instead of 0.58 microseconds per call, with the same results. Copying only on a change was measured to gain about 6 % more and is not done.
